sections.title: City opens the old ferry waiting room as a reading hall
sections.headline: Free tables, long hours, and a view of the channel
sections.body:
Port Meridian converted the unused ferry waiting room into a public reading hall this week, with long tables facing the channel and hours that run past the last boat.

The city says the room had sat empty since the foot-ferry moved to the new pier. Volunteers stocked the shelves from two closing bookshops on Harbor Street.

A Saturday morning paper hour is already on the board: bring a section, leave it for the next reader.

sections.title: Mill workers vote to keep the night shift
sections.headline: Harbor Mill stays on two ovens through winter
sections.body:
Harbor Mill's night crew voted to keep the second shift through March, after a week of counting sacks against winter orders from the inner towns.

The mill posted the result on the dock board at dawn. Bakers on the strip said the extra bags are what Saturday's market has been short of since August.
